First, the short circuit level at the busbar for generators in parallel is the sum of their individual short circuit capacities.  

Each alternator:  
Rating = 20 MVA  
Subtransient reactance \( X_d'' = 16\% = 0.16 \, \text{p.u.} \)  

Short circuit MVA for one machine = \( \frac{\text{Base MVA}}{X_d''} = \frac{20}{0.16} = 125 \, \text{MVA} \)  

Four machines in parallel:  
Total short circuit MVA = \( 4 \times 125 = 500 \, \text{MVA} \)  

Final answer: (A)
